description: Deterministic fixes applied to the pinned decompiled DTS before dtc compilation. The decompiler renders a 32-bit cell whose bytes are all printable as a string literal; dtc then re-parses \02 as an octal escape, so this property is restored explicitly. The uart14 node is additionally enabled with its Bluetooth child so hci_uart can bind the WCN7850.

replacements.why: decompiled 00 32 4b 00 was emitted as a C string '\02K', which dtc compiles as bytes 02 4b 00 (150272 uV instead of 3294976 uV); the explicit cell restores the accepted value

replacements.new: serial@898000 { 				compatible = "qcom,geni-uart"; 				reg = <0x00 0x898000 0x00 0x4000>; 				clock-names = "se"; 				clocks = <0x30 0x7b>; 				pinctrl-names = "default"; 				pinctrl-0 = <0x47 0x48>; 				interrupts = <0x00 0x1cd 0x04>; 				interconnects = <0x32 0x02 0x00 0x32 0x05 0x00 0x33 0x02 0x00 0x34 0x1d 0x00>; 				interconnect-names = "qup-core\0qup-config"; 				status = "okay"; 				phandle = <0x12f>;  					bluetooth { 						compatible = "qcom,wcn7850-bt"; 						max-speed = <0x30d400>; 					};
replacements.why: uart14 carries the WCN7850 Bluetooth transport (gpio78/79 + cts/rts on gpio76/77). It was left disabled in the vendor dump; enabling it with a qcom,wcn7850-bt child lets hci_uart bind and pwrseq_qcom_wcn drive the PMU enable GPIO. max-speed 0x30d40 = 3200000.
